text: Implemented a typed FitInterpreter layer for existing executable engines. FitPlanExecutor now delegates through FitInterpreters; FitChunkProgram preparation and merge also use the same interpreter context. Added regression coverage for built-in interpreter lookup, deferred RobustLeastSquares refusal, and chunk program engine binding. Verification: sbt fitJVM/test passed 89 tests; sbt fitJS/test passed 86 tests; reserved diff passed git diff --check.
